name: Mocha Java Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 150 mg per can, printed as the caffeine-content line under the ingredients; the side panel repeats 150 mg of natural caffeine
summary: Cocoa-powder cold brew latte on lactose-free ultra-filtered skim milk: 10 g of protein and 150 mg of caffeine per 11 oz can, at 140 calories and 22 g of sugar (21 g of it added). Its panel differs from the vanilla and caramel cans in two places: 160 mg of sodium against their 150 mg, and under 1 g of fiber against 0 g.
